title: What Non-Technical Teams Build With AI: Finance, HR, and Operations Tools That Replace SaaS
summary: Finance, HR, and operations teams are building custom tools with AI — budget trackers, onboarding apps, vendor managers — without writing code or waiting for IT.
body_markdown: The core difference is customization depth and cost structure. Airtable costs $20/user/month and shapes your workflow around its data model. Notion works well for documentation but lacks real auth and approval logic. A tool built with Blink matches your exact workflow — because you described it. For most non-technical teams, the right first build is whatever they're currently managing in their most painful spreadsheet.
